description: Order the WYOMING ANNUAL REPORT filing service for a company we formed (product wy_annual_report, flat US$149/year all-in: preparation, state filing, and the state's minimum license tax). Wyoming requires the report on the first day of the anniversary month every year; missing it leads to administrative dissolution, which can freeze bank and processor accounts. Pass the ORIGINAL formation request_id. Returns an order with TWO payment options: a Stripe checkout_url for the human owner, or an exact USDC/USDT amount the agent can pay autonomously — filing starts automatically once payment is detected. Reminders also go out automatically at 60/30/7 days before the due date.
